manifest.analysis: static local audit only; no proprietary binary exported and no USB command emitted

static_private_firmware_audit.limitations: Stock RV32 disassembly includes unrecognized chip extensions and calls into device ROM. Enum RESET_BCPU alone does not prove a callback or acknowledgement; no recovery command emitted.

verifier_initial_failure.classification: private verifier expected a full sysfs port string in QMP hostport instead of separate hostbus/hostport; VM and raw control observations unchanged
verifier_initial_failure.corrected_by: Exact usb_properties(host_port,0) check and joined bus-port lookup; both original runs reverified, no producer rerun or normalized error

protocol_basis.meaning: HCC high-priority memory count; not native DLI command credits or BSP/BSLE Ready ACK
protocol_basis.host_control_mode: ordinary original usb-host control callback, no emulation of 0xa105

reproduction.probe: tools/ws73_vm_register_reset.py --usb-credit-read-only --output <unique evidence dir> only inside signed private QEMU scratch root; exact ws73.register_reset_lab=1 ws73.usb_credit_lab=1 boot selectors
reproduction.prepare: tools/ws73_target.py prepare freezes K292 signed module inputs, Ud749 compiled service, user tools, qualified no-USB root smoke and same default host-libusb QEMU
reproduction.verification: Both joined VM runs independently pair exact a105000000000400 submission with original four-byte reply, capture counts/drop0, unique actual usb-host request/complete and libusb control success; no target bulk/reset/hub changes

conclusions: Two independent real WS73 VM control queries, ports2/1 with the other three host devices unowned, return four bytes 00000000. Each uses one SDK class-IN request5 after exclusive interface0 and exact runtime descriptor; raw HCC memory credit0 preserved.

Guest pcap each has65 packets/drop0, unique matched original four-byte credit completion, and zero target bulk. Actual usb-host req0xa105 and original successful length4 completion plus libusb control reap/status0 support this control observation. No class setter, register write, reset, hub power action or WS73 module load was requested.
Before/after complete runtime descriptor, four host inventory entries and parent/hub/target suspended-time counters remain unchanged. This is not active Ready peer, RF or recovery isolation.

The observation distinguishes a completing SDK EP0 control read from earlier failing EP01/EP02 bulk. It does not prove that the firmware core is healthy, establish a current firmware version, or explain bulk failure.

Zero high-priority memory credit is a new diagnostic clue, not a natural root cause. SDK data flow control reserves a USB control buffer, and the existing route/register failures need independent explanation; do not bypass bootstrap admission or force flow/reset based on this raw word.

Static111 image header validates. Device USB control paths call ROM and stock disassembly lacks chip-specific instructions; RESET_BCPU is only a host enum in supplied sources. Blind reset/flow forcing and invented ACK are prohibited, no reset message emitted.

Probe remains a VM-only isolated diagnostic; production Linux/Rust and historical real WS73 evidence remain unchanged. Normal gate attempts7, maintenance attempts20, real Managed successes0. Source tests292 and CI9 success do not qualify whole Managed/Ready/recovery gates.

Root cause, per-device bounded independent automatic recovery, no-daemon-restart restoration and all original issue scopes remain OPEN. Pending hub/WS73 supply topology must not be replaced by another blind ganged re-enumeration cycle.
